name: Investcorp Holdings B.S.C.
note: Bahrain-based alternative investment firm, delisted from the Bahrain Bourse in 2021. Its March 2026 corporate presentation (figures as of 31 December 2025) gives shareholders: Investcorp employees 29% (including 9.9% treasury shares), Mubadala 20%, other GCC sovereign entities (three shareholders) 33%, GCC merchant families 18%; Mubadala's VP of financial services Yasir Aqil Badri sits on the board; the same board list also names Sh. Abdulrahman Al-Thani, 'Minister of State, State of Qatar', as a board member. POC has been in its portfolio since 2015.
